Requirements / negotiation points:
- Min tokens/sec target: customer initial ask 100k sustained; Redwood proposed contractual min 75k with scheduled scale windows to 200k for bursts.
- Concurrency cap: customer wants hard cap at 250 concurrent streams to prevent noisy neighbors; Redwood proposes concurrency shaping + per-route limits and circuit-breakers.
- Burst policy: need 10-minute burst allowance up to 2.5x baseline for settlement spikes; penalty-free if inside scheduled burst budget; beyond that SLA credits apply.
- Latency SLO: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 250ms for 128-token responses; p99 remediation triggers credits + expedited remediation plan.
- Reserved GPU planning: recommended starting 12 reserved GPUs (A100-class equivalent) with ~10% spare headroom; phased ramp from 6 -> 12 over 60 days contingent on test gates.
- Data/control plane: VPC private control plane, KMS integration scheduled for March; legal requires log retention policy and audit hooks.
